sections.heading: Why insurance
sections.body: Insurance protects your family and assets from large, unexpected costs (death, illness, accident). For breadwinners and OFWs, life and health coverage can ensure dependents are not left in difficulty.

sections.heading: What to consider
sections.body: Start with life and health insurance that fits your budget. Compare term life vs whole life; often term is cheaper for the same coverage. In the Philippines, consider PhilHealth and employer plans, then top up with private insurance if needed.
